_comment: Small parameter tables that feed the general electrochemistry model (master plan section 7.4, decision D3): exchange current densities of the hydrogen / oxygen evolution reactions per electrode element, and limiting ionic molar conductivities. Values are the recalled literature numbers (Trasatti, J. Electroanal. Chem. 39 (1972) 163; Conway & Bockris; Bard & Faulkner appendix; CRC Handbook limiting ionic conductivities at 298.15 K); tier: estimated. Condition-dependent behaviour is derived by the model, these are only the intrinsic prefactors.
